propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the expected external effect (using the same helpers as the production code) instead of capturing it from a real call site stay green when the production code drifts, defeating their purpose.

Two instances occurred in the same module: truncate_comment_body model became stale when send path moved to AdfCodec.fit_outbound; a fix draft re-derived the composition and passed CI while breaking live convergence.
The concrete defect was fixed by capturing --body from real acli_cli_ops.add_comment calls with only boundary stubbed, but no documented rule guides test authors toward the correct pattern.

A mechanical lint to flag re-derived oracles cannot distinguish sanctioned uses (characterization tests that deliberately pin fit helpers identically) from defective ones without unacceptable false positives.
The rule must be recorded as authoring guidance in the shared test-design standard at examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md §4 with both historical instances as worked examples.
